question: How must an applicant prove their language ability?

claims.text: An applicant must prove their language ability by taking an approved language test.
claims.quote: You must prove your language skills by taking an approved language test.

basis: Applicant Alex Taylor (Candidate ID: 555123) submitted an IELTS General Training test dated 2025-11-01 (expiry 2027-11-01) with scores: Listening 8.0, Reading 8.0, Writing 8.0, Speaking 8.0 (Overall 8.0 / CLB 9).

Document defect flag: The test result form is marked defective and unverifiable under failure code PFL-LANGUAGE-02 (TRF Number Mismatch / Unverifiable Results). Registration Number (0000000000000000), TRF Number (00CA000000TAY000X), and Test PIN (00000000) contain invalid zeroed values, and official provider database verification returned no matching record, triggering an A40 misrepresentation flag.
